newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.
newsitem.headline: Mikuni assigns preliminary bond credit ratings.

text.p: Mikuni and Co Ltd said on Friday it had assigned the following preliminary ratings to planned bond issues:
Tokyo Radiator Mfg Co Ltd, 23 million marks unsecured due 2001, private placement, guaranteed by Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank.
-BB-
Juntendo Co Ltd, 5 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2004.
Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company Inc,
10 billion yen unsecured due 2001.
10 billion yen unsecured due 2003.
Nippon Conlux Co Ltd, 0.15 billion yen unsecured with warrants due 2000.
Shinagawa Fuel Co Ltd, 5 billion yen unsecured due 2001.
Chubu Gas Company Ltd, 3 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003.
Daiichi Cement Co Ltd, 4 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2003.
Ohba Co Ltd, 40 million Swiss Francs unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
Shindengen Electric Mfg Co Ltd,
3 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement. 7 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2005.
Tasaki Shinju Co Ltd, 12 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
Zenchiku Company Ltd, 4 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
-CCC-
Akebono Brake Industry Co Ltd, 10 billion yen unsecured convertible due 2005.
Fuji Corp Ltd, 20 million Swiss francs unsecured convertible due 2000, private placement.
Iseki & Co Ltd, 4 billion yen unsecured due 2003.
